name: Shandong Sino-Agri United Biotechnology Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: Shandong Sino-Agri United Biotechnology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of pesticide production in the whole industry chain, such as pesticide intermediates, technical and preparation products. Its products include imidacloprid, acetamiprid, nitenpyram, pyridaben and other pesticide raw materials, intermediates and pesticides, fungicides, and herbicides. The company was founded on December 19, 2006 and is headquartered in Jinan, China.
